newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Six Colombian governors suspended in lotto scam.
newsitem.headline: Six Colombian governors suspended in lotto scam.

text.p: Six Colombian governors have been suspended from office for mishandling money raised through the national lottery, government officials said on Wednesday.

Attorney General Jaime Bernal Cuellar said the governors, who were suspended without pay, had failed to ensure that funds raised through the 9 Millionaria lottery were transferred as mandated into the state-run public health system.
Four of the governors were also accused of misappropriating lottery revenues to cover local government payrolls, judicial officials said.
The suspensions, which are subject to an appeal, would prevent the governors from carrying out any official activities for 70 to 80 days.
